cases.scenario: A same-origin update is offered while a draft is dirty.
cases.expected_action: Keep A approved and defer the service-worker/build switch until the draft is safely resolved and the user accepts the update.

cases.scenario: A device has pending encrypted operations during A-to-B activation.
cases.expected_action: Preserve operation IDs and ciphertext hashes across the switch; do not clear or rewrite the pending queue.

cases.scenario: The server commits a push but its response is lost before the client receives the ACK.
cases.expected_action: Retry the byte-identical envelope and observe exactly one server-side effect for its operation ID.

cases.scenario: A tab is frozen or suspended while a new build is waiting.
cases.expected_action: Do not treat the suspended tab as update consent; keep its approved build until an explicit safe transition occurs.

cases.scenario: The candidate has an incomplete or failed asset installation.
cases.expected_action: Keep A available and approved; do not activate B until its required assets and health checks pass.

cases.scenario: A Flight response is in flight during cutover and the browser later requests a static asset emitted only by A.
cases.expected_action: Keep the response bound to its originating build and serve retained A-only static assets from the previous web image.

cases.scenario: B has written data and a rollback to A is explicitly compatible with the current database and client protocols.
cases.expected_action: Switch binaries only; retain the current database, keys, and writes made while B was active.

cases.scenario: A does not advertise support for the current database revision or protocol state.
cases.expected_action: Reject rollback before activation, keep healthy B serving, and use the documented roll-forward path if recovery is needed.

cases.scenario: An interrupted MySQL DDL migration leaves a partial schema on a disposable database.
cases.expected_action: Readiness remains failed until the verified fixture repair is applied and a forward retry reaches the packaged head.

cases.scenario: Restore snapshot S into a second isolated target and reconnect the same two persistent profiles after a new epoch is prepared.
cases.expected_action: Reconcile the baseline E0, acknowledged shadow events E1/E2, pending P0, and unchanged encrypted draft without duplicate effects; both devices converge.

supporting_gates.scenario: Disposable MySQL interruption, readiness failure, verified repair, and forward retry.
supporting_gates.reason: Docker Desktop engine access was denied in the current environment; the integration fixture was not run.

supporting_gates.scenario: IndexedDB v1-to-v2 migration preserves the journal and outbox; a future unsupported version fails safely.
supporting_gates.reason: The real-browser release suite has not run against an approved HTTPS target.
